title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. Although I preheat this every morning, after 2 - 3 hours, the coffee is no longer hot, just warm.  Worse, I am temporarily using a stove-top percolator  so the coffee is super hot when I pour it in.  I am sure once I go back to my drip coffee maker, it will only last hot for an hour or so.

product_metadata.title: Copco Chloe Thermal Carafe, 1 Quart, White
features: keeps drinks hot or cold for up to 8 hours
description: Copco carafes are styled to make a statement in the board room or the living room. Practical features that make serving a pleasure! Chloe Carafe 1 Quart capacity vacuumed glass liner that keeps drinks hot or cold for up to 8 hours. Elongated push-button mechanism and curved handle for easy pouring. Warm, inviting profile available in white.
Place warm tap water in Carafe to heat cylinder prior to adding the hot liquid. If hot liquid is added to cold carafe, it can cause the glass cylinder to crack therefore not keeping liquids hot.
